population: original Regulatory T cells, re-encoded with the expanded VAE
failed_cell_policy: Per source, test only paired baseline/zero predictions for cells with absolute decoded source <= tolerance. Cell subsets can differ across TFs. With fewer than two passing cells, mark tests not performed and export no edges.
source_selection: Original Section 8 tf_top: top 30 path-variance TFs; only VAE-output TFs can be simulated
method: independent fixed-VAE latent optimization per source; decoded source target zero
constraint_refinement: After the original penalty schedule, minimum-norm decoder-gradient steps with per-cell backtracking for residual > tolerance only.
BH_scope: 2020 targets separately per source, not global across 30 sources
selection: rank_sum_q_BH < FDR; abs_power >= median(abs_power of FDR-significant targets per source); power != 0
paired_test: Wilcoxon signed-rank with separate per-source BH; sensitivity only
interpretation: Associational model-response GRN, not direct or causal regulation. TF membership follows the existing broad TF list, not independently curated. Matched cell predictions are not independent biological replicates.
